cues.text: Find what waits for your decision, read the request, and approve, reject or ask for more information.
Approvals & tasks opens on My day: everything on your plate in one place.
Requests waiting for your decision come first, the most urgent at the top. Overdue ones are marked in red.
Open a request to see the details, the amount and who asked.
Your decision is here. On a phone these buttons are large and come first.
Add a note. A note is required to reject or to ask a question.
Not sure? Ask for more information: the request goes back to the person who asked, and the deadline clock pauses.
Approve. The person who asked is told at once, and the next step, if any, goes to its approver.
Every decision, comment and reminder stays in the request's history.
